text:
oncall-bot: PAGER: Streaming tail latency p99 spike detected in eu-west2 (service=streaming-ingest) — automatic paging triggered.

sahil: seeing this in dashboards, p99 up from ~120ms to 2.1s for streaming append RPCs. p95 also elevated.

marta: confirmed alerts. Affected customers: 3 active streams with realtime sync. CS reporting one customer seeing rebuffering.

ryan: I'm on pager, joining. quick check — any recent deploys to eu-west2?

kevin-sre: no user-facing deploys in region for last 90m. infra autoscaler bumped pods ~10:03UTC.

sahil: digging into egress metrics — cross-zone NAT connections show retransmits + TLS handshake spikes starting 10:02.

marta: logs snippet from one ingester: ```
2026-02-12T10:02:21Z WARN stream_write tail_latency=2150ms err=write timeout
2026-02-12T10:03:05Z INFO connection tls_handshake_time=880ms dst_nattgt=eu-west2a
```

ryan: that looks like NAT/hairpin pathing. Any packetloss graphs?

kevin-sre: tcp_retransmit rate jumped at 10:02 across azb->azc. Also per-link ECN increased. Could be inter-AZ route flaps.

sahil: running `curl -v https://ingest.eu-west2.internal/health` against a few nodes — TLS handshake often stalls, sometimes hangs ~1s before completing.

marta: customer impact: CS says two customers saw 5-10% increase in tail latency and one reported streaming stalls affecting user experience. Marking P1-customer visible.

oncall-bot: runbook link: https://runbooks/internal/streaming-tail-latency. Recommended mitigations: failover traffic to eu-west3, enable legacy routing fallback.

ryan: I'll start traffic steering to eu-west3 via routing policy change (canary 20% -> 100%). Sahil, can you validate model variants / cache warming?

sahil: will warm KV caches in eu-west3 and pre-populate hot prefixes. Also enabling prefix caching at edge to reduce cross-zone egress.

kevin-sre: pushing a temporary NAT egress rebind to avoid ephemeral port exhaustion on eu-west2 nodes. This should reduce handshake retries.

marta: informing CS and affected customers: @cs-bot please push status update to impacted accounts and post note in status.redwood.ai.

cs-bot: Draft posted to customers: "We are investigating elevated streaming tail latency in eu-west2; mitigation in progress. We will update within 15 minutes."

ryan: steer applied: 20% -> 100% to eu-west3 at 10:11UTC. Monitoring now.

sahil: metrics: p99 dropping from 2.1s -> 350ms within 90s of steer. p95 back to baseline. TCP retransmits falling.

kevin-sre: NAT ephemeral ports freed after rebind; handshake success rate improving. Packetloss still a bit noisy on azc uplink, but traffic is already offloaded.

marta: CS confirmed customer A saw rebuffering stop. Marking customer impact mitigated.

ryan: leaving follow-up items: (1) infra to run inter-AZ path tests and file ticket with cloud provider; (2) make NAT rebind automation for quick remediations; (3) add alert for TLS handshake time > 500ms per-AZ.

sahil: I'll capture stack traces and attach a trace sample to the incident channel. Also capturing pre/post steer histograms for the postmortem.

oncall-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Please add postmortem tag and assign owner.

marta: assigning postmortem to ryan; ETA draft by EOD. Adding runbook updates for NAT rebind and routing failover.

ryan: thanks — will open postmortem and escalate to networking. Good job team. :thumbsup:
